next_decisive_test.why_decisive: It crosses the real Chrome content-script, service-worker relay, and sidepanel boundaries that the passing unit checks mock, while proving both stale-session rejection and current-session extraction on real repeated-card data.
procedure: Build from audited HEAD 015cfba66cb23063825a323dd2a711ee04138995 using the repository's existing stabilization resource guard and freeze the resulting development artifact before opening Chrome.

Load/reload exactly that frozen unpacked artifact in the intended Chrome profile; record extension version, source SHA, artifact directory/tree hash, and build receipt. Confirm the browser-loaded artifact matches the frozen receipt and contains the current ListPatternTab and picker code before interacting.

Open Showcase → List Pattern on a regular page with repeated event cards. Start picker A and pause its outgoing ITEM_DETECTED, RESULT, and EXIT separately at the runtime-delivery boundary. Cancel A, start B without changing tab or URL, then release each held A message separately. Each must leave B active and its builder/config unchanged.

With B still active, defer A's cancellation injection until B has started, then release it. B must remain usable. Select a repeated card with B, select a field, press Done, and Extract; require current B data in the rows.

While a pick is active, reinject the picker content context and click one card; require exactly one detection. Close/cancel the picker and click a normal page link/button; require ordinary page interaction to resume.

Record each observed action/result against the frozen artifact receipt. Preserve the run transcript and a concise evidence artifact; classify any unexercised delivery channel or failed precondition as unverified, and keep D42 open until the whole acceptance succeeds.
preconditions: Healthy admission from the existing browser/resource guard immediately before browser work; no bypass or threshold change.
A regular repeated-card page and a Chrome profile with the extension installed and controllable.

A reliable runtime-boundary hold/release mechanism for each outbound picker channel and cancellation injection. If the existing native harness cannot delay these events, the test cannot decisively cover D42; report that limitation rather than substituting mocked delivery for native proof.

A frozen development build from the audited source SHA, with exact extension version, output path, artifact/tree hash, build command/receipt, and confirmation the loaded extension is that artifact. Any source change after freezing requires a new build/receipt and restart of this test.
